subject: Encryption evidence request: KM telemetry & ceremony witness for SOC 2 / SIG
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@edgecloud.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Menon <p.menon@edgecloud.com>, EdgeCloud Security <security@edgecloud.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Request: KM telemetry + ceremony witness for SOC 2 / SIG

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking the time last week on the onboarding call. Our SOC 2 auditor and SIG lead are asking for a compact package showing:
- HSM ceremony artifacts (logs + witness notes) for the tenant keystore used for our BYOK onboarding;
- Rotation manifest and operator ACLs for the past 12 months;
- Sample KV-cache telemetry showing how prefix caching affects tokenization and potential plaintext caching surface.

I realize some of this is sensitive. Our ask is twofold: a written package we can stash in the audit binder, and the option to observe a short ceremony replay/witness over Zoom (30–45m). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
1) Redacted ceremony logs and a short narrative of operator actions;
2) A CSV sample of KV-cache telemetry (anonymized) covering the last month;
3) Rotation manifest signed by your operator leads.

If there are prerequisites (NDAs, scoped redaction guidance, or an on-site witness policy), please let us know. We aim to complete our SIG response by 04/10, so an expedited turnaround would help.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Security Operations
EdgeCloud Inc.
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@edgecloud.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <p.menon@edgecloud.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KM telemetry + ceremony witness for SOC 2 / SIG

Sanjay —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can provide the package and a witness session. We'll need to redact operator usernames and any tenant-specific secrets; we can provide hashes/commit ids instead.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in our encryption evidence owner (Marissa) and the account rep for scheduling (Ben).
- Can you confirm whether the auditor needs full timestamps or timezone-normalized logs? Also confirm the witness window you prefer (04/06–04/09).

I'll get an initial bundle together and propose a witness time by EOD tomorrow.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: EdgeCloud request — KM telemetry + ceremony witness (SOC 2 / SIG)

Team — forwarding the request from EdgeCloud (see below). This is time-boxed (SIG response target 04/10). Action items I need from owners:

Marissa — encryption evidence owner: can you assemble a compact package that contains the following items (redacted where noted) and indicate any gaps?
- HSM ceremony logs for tenant edgecloud-01 covering the March ceremony (prefer a .zip with a README). Redact operator UIDs; include hashes of private material instead of plaintext keys.
- A one-page narrative (PDF) of the ceremony steps, operator separation of duties, and witness chain-of-custody.
- Rotation manifest (signed by operator leads).
- Short playbook note on how we redact and what we will not disclose.

Ben — account rep: coordinate scheduling for the witness session; propose 2 slots (30–45m) between 04/06 and 04/09. Also manage the NDA redaction appendix if EdgeCloud needs an addendum.

Lauren — legal/finance ops: any procurement or NDAs needed to share signed operator manifests or long-term retention artifacts? Please advise on minimal legal guardrails.

Timing: please aim to have a draft bundle by 04/04 EOD so we can iterate once with EdgeCloud. If anything requires more time (forensics or re-keys), flag immediately.

Thanks — I expect this to be a compact deliverable but high sensitivity, so follow the redaction playbook.

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 09:18 Sanjay Rao <sanjay@edgecloud.com> wrote:
> Hi Rishi,
> 
> Thanks for taking the time last week on the onboarding call. Our SOC 2 auditor and SIG lead are asking for a compact package showing: ...

—Rishi
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-05T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeCloud request — KM telemetry + ceremony witness (SOC 2 / SIG)

Rishi / Ben —

Attached is the first pass of the evidence bundle for EdgeCloud. Files attached to this thread (attachment stubs):
- hsm-ceremony-log-202703.zip (redacted operator UIDs; includes README.md describing redaction mapping)
- kvcache-telemetry-sample-202703.csv (anonymized prefixes; TTLs and token counts only)
- rotation-manifest-202703.pdf (signed by operator leads; redaction appendix included)

What we included in the bundle:
1) Ceremony narrative (README inside the zip): step-by-step timeline, witness list (roles only), and verification hashes for the ephemeral keys.
2) Operator separation table (roles only; no emails or full names).
3) Telemetry extract: 30-day rolling sample showing prefix-hit ratios and median token latencies; we removed request ids and any plaintext content.

Open items / flags:
- Auditor asked for timezone-normalized timestamps. The logs currently are in UTC; I can convert and stamp them if EdgeCloud prefers local-time alignment.
- The auditor also asked for a short recording of the ceremony (witnessed). Per our policy we can offer a live witness session or a live replay with redactions, but we do not record live operator credentials.
- Legal: rotation-manifest includes operator signatures; if EdgeCloud requires signatures with full employee names we need a redaction addendum signed by both parties (assigned to Lauren).

Ben — I propose witnesses slots: 2027-04-07 09:00–09:45 PT or 2027-04-08 14:00–14:45 PT. Please confirm with Sanjay and log in a calendar invite (include our compliance Zoom link).

Sanjay / EdgeCloud — once you confirm timezone preference and witness slot, we will:
- Produce a timezone-normalized copy if requested;
- Share the bundle via secure SharePoint link (I included the draft link in related_links);
- Host a 30–45m witness session with the Redaction playbook on screen.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Encryption Evidence Owner, Redwood Inference
Attachments: hsm-ceremony-log-202703.zip (attachment stub), kvcache-telemetry-sample-202703.csv (attachment stub), rotation-manifest-202703.pdf (attachment stub)
